Definition: Overall analyses use 152 genomes. Reference-group comparisons use 144 genomes (23 subflava, 114 perflava, 7 flavescens). Eight species-unresolved genomes contribute to the overall model but are excluded from reference-group comparisons.
Strict core: 152/152; core: 151/152; soft core: 145–150/152; shell: 23–144/152; cloud: 1–22/152. Main figures combine strict core and core as core ≥99%.

PGAP2 orth98 is primary; orth95 is the identity-threshold sensitivity dictionary. Cluster identifiers are not interchangeable. Group repertoires use subsets of the shared orth98 dictionary, not independent reconstructions.

reference_groups_144 uses 23/114/7 genomes. ANI_assignment_sensitivity_152 assigns all 152 genomes by ANI channel (31/114/7), including eight species-unresolved genomes. Mantel tests use all 152 genomes. all_variable includes every non-strict-core cluster.

PERMANOVA uses raw Jaccard distances. PERMDISP uses bias-adjusted distances to group medians with Lingoes correction and residual permutations. restricted_within_study_namespace denotes within-study permutations; 999 draws per test.
Coordinates use shell/cloud Jaccard distances and Lingoes correction. Axis fractions use positive corrected eigenvalues.
Means and 2.5th–97.5th percentiles come from 1,000 random genome orders. Intervals describe order variation, not confidence intervals from independent biological replicates.

Panstripe 0.4.0, maximum-parsimony ancestral reconstruction; Gaussian identity-link model: acc ~ 0 + istip + core + depth + istip:core. acc is the inferred number of gene presence/absence changes per branch; core is branch length, not a core-gene count.

All four default Tweedie fits failed to converge within the default iteration limit. The supported Gaussian alternative was applied uniformly. Coefficients are linear associations, not exponentiated rate ratios.

Models use the same unmasked IQ-TREE phylogeny and shared PGAP2 dictionary. Group subtrees preserve substitutions/site distances. overall_midpoint inherits the overall root; group_midpoint independently midpoint-roots each group subtree.

1,000 branch-bootstrap replicates per model and comparison. Comparisons resample within each group. Percentile 95% CIs were recalculated from finite, full-rank coefficient vectors; bootstrap_valid reports retained replicates.
Estimates are group B minus group A. P values are model-based t tests. BH q values cover three core comparisons per rooting; the six tip/depth comparisons form a separate secondary family.

CONDITIONAL_ON_TREE denotes an estimate conditional on this phylogeny. INFLUENTIAL_BRANCH flags sensitivity to an influential branch. SMALL_GROUP_ROOT_SENSITIVE flags the 7-genome group and associated comparisons, whose estimates have wide intervals and depend on rooting.

The tree is not recombination-filtered or time-calibrated. Heterogeneous residual variance, small-group influence and rooting sensitivity limit interpretation. The results do not establish a robust group-rate ranking or an open/closed pangenome classification.
